comparison.objective: Press two new floor tiles flush with adjacent laid tiles, versus fracture and recover four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar placement and distributed seating force versus narrow-tool alignment, localized hammer impact, lateral-force control, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Two tiles end flush with neighbors versus four notch fractures, four recovered tangs, and no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both apply force, but distributed seating without fracture is materially different from calibrated impact fracture and fragment containment. Flushness and damage thresholds are absent.
